query: SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', date), '%Y-%m') AS month, count(DISTINCT tx_hash) AS txs FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash, script_hash AS h FROM transaction_scripts WHERE date in <year window> UNION ALL SELECT date, tx_hash, owner_payment_credential AS h FROM address_utxo WHERE date >= DATE '2021-09-01' AND date < DATE '2022-01-01') WHERE h IN ('5986bfcc0cbfc60dec8df87715cc95d03817aac386b0e9d33da03b39', '73e4aea31b5b51d9b0ca386196fc6a4c422f74c5aea011e4b8bdf4e5')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
